fields.validation_summary: Initial perf harness landed. Representative e2e timings: move preflight about 117ms; move execute about 11254ms; move rollback about 11086ms; move execute with missing tracked refs about 8709ms; health representative case wall time about 162870ms with phase breakdown scan about 10193ms, list about 37ms, workflow about 35ms, collect_findings about 362ms on 121 tickets / 118 edges / 265 findings. Criterion benchmark: move_preflight_reference_heavy about 244-276ms. Health benchmark harness compiles; full health benchmark run is still heavy and should be used for optimization follow-up.

fields.title: [ticket-api][perf] Characterize slow ticket move and health end-to-end
fields.validation_summary: Added second perf slice: dedicated open_or_init/scan benches, move phase timings in journals, heavier fixture presets, and sequential heavy move coverage. New evidence: sequential heavy moves took about 27.8s and 28.0s with phase timings dominated by scan_target_ms about 22.3s and scan_source_ms about 5.3s; rename/rewrite/validate were negligible in that case. Criterion also reported open_or_init_root_perf_fixture is extremely slow, projecting about 376s for 10 samples, which strongly suggests store bootstrap/open is another major bottleneck alongside scan work.

fields.title: [ticket-api][perf] Characterize slow ticket move and health end-to-end
fields.validation_summary: Added third perf slice: internal store profiling now records open_or_init and scan sub-phases, plus 1, 10, and 100 change incremental scan coverage. New evidence from the large health fixture: open_or_init_total_ms was about 19535 and split almost evenly between bootstrap_scan_manifest_bootstrap_ms about 9779 and post_init_scan_ms about 9721, indicating a near double-scan on bootstrap. scan(true) took about 9579 ms and was dominated by integrate_root_0_tickets_ms about 7799 and rebuild_workflow_facts_ms about 1749, while scan_root_0_tickets_ms was only about 13. Incremental scan(false) remained dominated by integration and workflow recompute rather than directory walking: 1 change about 11115 ms, 10 changes about 11351 ms, and 100 changes about 20314 ms, with scan_root staying about 12 to 24 ms. Together with the earlier move timings, this points to index integration, workflow fact rebuild, and repeated bootstrap scans as the main slow paths rather than filesystem discovery.
